pallets/werkzeug.body_preview: When a `Request` is created, it sets `environ["werkzeug.request"] = self` if `populate_request=True` (the default). This would allow middleware to be built with Werkzeug that _can_ read `data` or `form` and have that (and cached parsed headers) still available to the application.
